item.tib: me ri gyad phur dbang rin chen 'bar ba'i lag len
item.coloph: de ltar me ri gyad phur gyi bsgrub pa'i dbang rin chen 'bar ba'i lag len 'di/ bdag tshe dbang rgyal pos yi ger btab pa dge legs 'phel/ zhang zhung snyan rgyud zung 'jug bskur thabs bla ma ba yas sa bcad bzhin no/ de byung dge ba'i rtsa ba ci mchis pa/ mkha' mnyam sems can don du bsngo/ yi dam mgon po rnam gsum sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med shog bkra shis par shog/
